input.query: original weak reference r + [(dx,dy) for dy in(-3,0,3) for dx in(-3,0,3)]

input.L: exact V60 crop_sides native query span formula clip(.25*max(ptp(q8,axis=0)),16,max(H,W)), computed on new tuple and shared across views
input.local_operator: exact C11 bilinear crop96 followed by central32 crop; no oracle128 reuse
input.features: same frozen DINO C11 1928 operator T/Q/F/C/P and8scalar, actual fractional valid, Q outside not extraU

label_interpretation: Existing weak region/component/cue visibility D before/E after. Small query shifts can retain cue label despite material edge crossing; not per-query target pixel membership or native corner equality. All37+uncertainty+folds retained. No nine-independent-corner claim.
selector_or_arm: No model or threshold choice. One already-frozen C14, all666 retained. Source VAL is development exposed.
outputs: Input-only666 JSONL separate from unchanged weak evidence; features and predictions saved before evaluation join.
